name: Gerald L. Maatman, Jr.
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in Chicago, Illinois
about: Gerald L. Maatman, Jr. is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2027. He works at Duane Morris LLP, located in Chicago, Illinois, and provides legal services for issues involving Employment & Labor and Business Litigation to the surrounding community.
Gerald Maatman, Jr. completed legal studies at Northwestern University School of Law and graduated with the class of 1981. Gerald Maatman, Jr. passed the bar in 1981.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
